description.value: Mile One Eating House is a Pemberton institution founded in 2011, serving regionally inspired British Columbian comfort food with an emphasis on natural beef, local producers, and slow-food techniques. Signatures include natural beef burgers, slow-roasted brisket, pork belly sandwiches, and mac 'n' cheese, all sourced from regional farmers, ranchers, and artisans. Positioned as the beginning, middle, or end of a journey into BC's wild spaces, it's a natural refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the Pemberton Valley.
